bhgame.pulse_grass.hint: This grass breathes in a rhythm... wait for it to breathe out.
bhgame.twin_grass.waiting: Two roots twist together here... someone must hold the other side.
bhgame.twin_grass.hint: Pull when your root glows. When both glow, pull together.
bhgame.polarity_grass.hint: Yin and yang in this herb never rest... push the opposite qi against it.
bhgame.thunder_grass.hint: Lightning runs through the stem... ground it before it reaches your hands.
bhgame.wooden_dummy.hint: The dummy sends its forms... receive them all, in order.
bhgame.wooden_dummy.outcome.fail: An arm you failed to block knocks you back. Take your stance again.
bhgame.wooden_dummy.outcome.reached: The dummy knocks you back. You reached stage %s.
bhgame.session.too_far: You need to be right beside it.
bhgame.session.server_busy: Too many people are training right now. Try again shortly.
bhgame.session.partner_left: Your partner let go, and the roots tear between you.
bhgame.session.no_partner: Nobody came to hold the other side.
bhgame.herb.brute_warning: The roots still hold fast... forcing it out will tear them.
bhgame.herb.brute_force: The roots tear and the herb's qi lashes back at you.
bhgame.station.brute_force: The wood doesn't give an inch, and it strikes back.
bhgame.herb.outcome.perfect: The roots come free, whole and unharmed.
bhgame.herb.outcome.success: The herb comes free, its roots a little bruised.
bhgame.herb.outcome.fail: The herb withers in your hands.
bhgame.herb.outcome.aborted: You let go of the herb.
